item.title: Can AI take care of my plant? (because I can’t)
item.description: Twice a day, an AI agent reads my pot-plant’s sensors, looks at a photo of her and then decides which way to rotate her, watering her if required or adjusting the blinds or heater and then posts the result to Instagram
